achCases.caseTitle: Source of Regional Power Grid Telemetry Spoofing
achCases.description: Evaluate competing hypotheses regarding a 4-hour telemetry outage across the Eastern Grid Substation.

hypotheses.name: State-Sponsored APT Cyber Attack
hypotheses.description: Foreign military cyber warfare unit breached SCADA interface.

hypotheses.name: Rogue Insider / Disgruntled Contractor
hypotheses.description: Internal contractor with revoked privileges used cached keys.

hypotheses.name: Unannounced Firmware Update Glitch
hypotheses.description: Vendor pushed unvalidated firmware patch causing race condition.

hypotheses.name: Physical Fiber Severance via Construction
hypotheses.description: Accidental third-party contractor excavation cut primary optical line.

evidenceList.description: Firewall logs reveal IP connections from known bulletproof VPS subnet.
System config files modified at 02:14 AM using admin service account.
Vendor release notes mention an emergency bug fix distributed that morning.
Physical OT sensors show normal line voltage throughout outage window.

achCases.caseTitle: Authenticity of Leaked Diplomatic Peace Treaty Addendum
achCases.description: Evaluate competing hypotheses regarding an explosive PDF document alleging secret territorial concessions.

hypotheses.name: Authentic Whistleblower Leak
hypotheses.description: A genuine classified addendum leaked by a high-ranking diplomat.

hypotheses.name: Adversary Forgery with Real Letterhead
hypotheses.description: Foreign intelligence fabricated the text inside an authentic scanned header.

hypotheses.name: Domestic Political Disinformation
hypotheses.description: Opposing domestic faction fabricated the memo to derail treaty ratification.

hypotheses.name: Misunderstood Working Draft
hypotheses.description: An unofficial exploratory brain-storming draft never approved by leadership.

evidenceList.description: Document uses Calibri font while official Ministry standard is Times New Roman.
PDF metadata shows creation date in an UTC+3 timezone workstation.
The diplomat named as author was in public plenary session at timestamp.
Document was first published on an anonymous Russian imageboard.

achCases.caseTitle: Origin of Viral Biomedical Contagion Claim

hypotheses.name: Actual Unreported Containment Breach
hypotheses.description: A real biosafety level 4 breach occurred and is being suppressed.

hypotheses.name: State-Sponsored Biosecurity Info-Op
hypotheses.description: Foreign intelligence generated deepfakes and staged imagery to cause panic.

hypotheses.name: Commercial Clickbait Panic Grift
hypotheses.description: Online survivalist merchants fabricated the rumor to sell supplies.

hypotheses.name: Misinterpreted Scheduled Routine Drill
hypotheses.description: Civilians observed a planned disaster preparedness exercise and panicked.

evidenceList.description: Imagery matched 2014 Dallas Ebola drill archive on Getty Images.
Regional emergency dispatch 911 logs show zero hazmat calls.
Originating Twitter account was created 48h prior with Russian phone 2FA.
Survivalist gear merchant accounts quote-tweeted claim with affiliate links.
